maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new LC and mass spec instruments plus recurring consumables and service; instrument and consumable sales dominate, not repair-led.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly pharma, biotech, food, industrial and diagnostics labs paying privately; academic and government labs are minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through own instruments, consumables and software; occasional deals like Andrew Alliance and the BD Biosciences combination.

mission_critical.reason: Chromatography and mass spec systems are validated in regulated pharma workflows; switching needs method revalidation, retraining and downtime.

notes: Mix is uncertain after the 2026 BD Biosciences and Diagnostics combination; answers reflect the core Waters instruments business.
